name: Plaud
description: Plaud AI connects your voice recordings to Claude. Browse your recording library, read transcripts, get AI summaries, extract action items, and draft follow-up emails — all through natural conversation.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Plaud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Plaud to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.plaud.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Plaud MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Plaud scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Plaud MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plaud provides these MCP tools: list_files, get_file, get_note, get_transcript, and get_current_user.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Plaud?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Plaud in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Plaud requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Plaud failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Plaud scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Plaud is developed by Plaud. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
